features.summary: Site-defined directives: classes with a static regex whose init() rewrites the HTML.
features.usage: class YearDirective implements YassbDirective { static regex = /<!--\s*current-year\s*-->/g; constructor(private args: YassbDirectiveProps) {} init() { return { html: ..., data: {} }; } }  then customDirectives: [YearDirective]
features.rules: Built-in directives run first, then custom ones in the order of customDirectives; init() is called once per regex match with the HTML updated by the previous call, so directives must be idempotent; components are processed before the page that includes them (fileFullPath is the component in src, then the page in out); data values become { key } placeholders; YassbBaseDirective copies the props to protected fields; an exception or a missing html fails the build with the directive location.

features.summary: Site-defined functions that turn data into HTML for create-from-data-source and public-file-list.
features.usage: export function newsList({ source, options, lang }: RendererProps<News[], { limit?: number }>): string { ... }  then customRenderers: { newsList }
features.options: Props: source, sourcePath, options, lang, currentFilePath, config, frontMatterStore.
features.rules: A renderer returns a string and must not write files; without renderer attribute basicElement is used (warning), with an unknown name basicElement is used (error); a throwing renderer fails the build with the directive location and inserts nothing; emitted <span data-t="KEY"> is translated afterwards.

features.summary: Identity helper that types a configuration file.
features.usage: import { defineConfig } from 'yassb-web'; export default defineConfig({ siteHost: 'https://example.com' });
features.rules: Equivalent to `export default {...} as YassbConfig`; requires yassb-web installed in the site because it is a runtime import.

features.summary: src/assets is copied as it is to the output.
features.rules: Copied first, before pages; files with unchanged size and modification time are skipped; files deleted from src stay in the output unless cleanOut.

features.summary: Output scripts and styles are named after their entry and the site version.
features.usage: scripts/main.ts at version 1.2.0 → main-1-2-0.min.js; styles/styles.scss → styles-1-2-0.min.css
features.rules: Dots of the version become dashes; changing the version changes the URLs inserted by include-script-src / include-styles-src.

features.summary: The browser script entry is bundled with esbuild.
features.options: config.esbuildOptions (merged), config.webpackConfig (legacy, webpack from the site), workingDir.scripts / scriptsOutFolder.
features.rules: IIFE for the browser, target es2018, minified in build, inline source map in watch, process.env.NODE_ENV = "production", JSX settings from tsconfig.json; bundled in parallel and written at the end of the build; an empty entry is created if missing.

features.summary: The stylesheet entry is compiled with Sass, or with the site's stylesParser.
features.rules: Sass output is compressed, imports resolved from the file and from the project root; compiled after the pages; a Sass error or a throwing stylesParser fails the build; an empty entry is created if missing.

features.summary: Development server of watch and serve (not for production).
features.rules: /<lang>/... → <out>/<lang>/...; other paths → <out>/<first language>/..., then <out>/...; folders redirect to a trailing slash and serve index.html; not found → the home page with status 200; Range requests supported; if the port is busy the next ones are tried.

features.summary: Every problem is reported with a stable code, file, line and hint.
features.usage: error DATA_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND src/app/pages/index.html:12 …  /  yassb build --json  /  yassb docs diagnostics
features.rules: Pages are reported on their source file (pages/, the template, or the Markdown file); the same problem reported for a component and its page is kept once; fatal problems (exceptions in site code, invalid JSON, config errors) exit 1, others only with strict; missing translations are collected and summarised.

features.summary: In watch mode pages reload by themselves and show build errors.
features.usage: automatic in yassb watch (script injected before </body>, events on /__yassb/events)
features.rules: Reload after a page or script rebuild; CSS swapped without reload after a styles-only rebuild; a badge while rebuilding; an overlay lists the errors of the last build (code, file:line, message, hint), hidden when fixed; status also at /__yassb/status; reloads when the watch process restarts.

features.summary: Only one YASSB process at a time writes an output folder; a second one stops with a clear message.
features.usage: Running `yassb build` while `yassb watch` serves the same folder → error OUTPUT_LOCKED naming the other process.
features.rules: build and check hold the lock during the build; watch holds it for its whole session and its rebuilds share it; the lock file is in the system temporary folder (never in the output); a lock left by a process that no longer exists (crash, kill -9) is taken over (the message names the lock file to delete if its process id was reused); different output folders never conflict; the second process exits with code 1 without writing anything.

features.summary: The fixed order in which a build processes a site.
features.usage: yassb build, yassb watch, or programmatically: await runBuild({ strict: true }) in the project folder.
features.options: BuildOptions: watchMode, steps { html, styles, scripts }, strict, clean, outDir.
features.rules: config → beforeBuild → assets copy → scripts bundling starts → generate-from-files → for each language: copy pages (all files of pages/), list output files (url-to, sitemap), then per HTML page: components → front matter → built-in directives → custom directives → translation → post-processing of every HTML file of the output → styles → scripts written → afterBuild; directives left in a page after processing are reported.

features.summary: Last step for every HTML file of the output.
features.usage: automatic; customize with config.postProcessors and config.htmlMinificationOptions
features.rules: For every .html/.htm in the output (assets included): { key } placeholders → postProcessors in order → minification in build, or in watch the live-reload script before </body> and removal of the Content-Security-Policy meta; runs after translation.

features.summary: Configuration and site code can be TypeScript, TSX or JavaScript.
features.options: The site's tsconfig.json (jsx, decorators, class fields).
features.rules: Under Node each file is compiled on its own to CommonJS with esbuild (like ts-node --transpile-only): __dirname, relative imports and require work as in Node; no type checking; stack traces point to the TS lines; Bun runs TypeScript natively; a syntax error is reported with file and line.

features.summary: sitemap.xml lists every file of the output; it is also the list url-to searches.
features.options: config.siteHost (keeps the file and is the host of the URLs), config.sitemap: false (never written).
features.rules: Regenerated before each language is processed; includes assets and every file; without siteHost the host is http://fake.host/ and the file is deleted at the end of the build (after post-processing); post processors may replace it.

features.summary: yassb build: production build of the site.
features.options: --strict: exit 1 on any error; --clean: empty the output first (dot files kept); --out <dir>: build into another folder; --json: print { ok, durationMs, out, diagnostics } instead of logs.
features.rules: Pages minified with htmlMinificationOptions, scripts minified; exit code 1 when site code throws, the config cannot load, a data source/stylesheet is invalid, or with --strict on any error; prints a summary with error/warning counts.

features.summary: yassb check: builds the site and validates it; exit code 1 on errors.
features.options: --json: report { ok, counts, diagnostics }; --out <dir>: build into another folder; --no-links (same as --links=false): skip the link check.
features.rules: Builds in production mode (in the configured output unless --out), then adds: translation attributes left in pages, keys missing in some language file, keys never used, broken local href/src, components and data sources not used by any page, packages imported by site code but not declared in package.json; programmatic: checkProject().

features.summary: yassb docs [topic]: prints the guide shipped with the package (docs/guide.md).
features.usage: yassb docs   yassb docs renderers   yassb docs diagnostics   yassb docs --list   yassb docs features [id]
features.options: --list: list topics; topic: a section of the guide (by slug or words of its title); features [id]: the feature catalogue, the checklist of what documentation must cover; --json: the catalogue as JSON.
features.rules: Works offline in every project; the diagnostics topic also lists every diagnostic code.

features.summary: Command dispatch, help and version of the yassb command.
features.rules: Unknown commands print the help and exit 1; the command runs in the current folder, which is the project root.

features.summary: yassb inspect [query]: describes the project without building it.
features.usage: yassb inspect   yassb inspect --json   yassb inspect news.json   yassb inspect HOME.TITLE
features.options: --json: full manifest (pages, templates, components, dataSources, renderers, customDirectives, postProcessors, hooks, assets, i18n, diagnostics); query: file, data source, renderer, directive or i18n key.
features.rules: Read-only: loads the configuration but runs no renderer and writes nothing; directives are listed with file:line, components transitively, LANG paths expanded for every language; problems visible statically (missing files, unknown renderers, invalid options) are listed; programmatic: inspectProject().

features.summary: yassb new <name>: creates a project from the starter.
features.options: name (required): converted to kebab-case for the folder and package name.
features.rules: Refuses a non-empty existing folder; the starter has config/default.ts, a renderer in builder/, a data source, components, Sass and TypeScript entries, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md for coding agents, and yassb-web as devDependency.

features.summary: yassb serve: serves the output folder without building.
features.rules: Uses the same routing as watch, without live reload; loads the configuration only to find the output folder and languages.

features.summary: yassb watch: build, serve with live reload, rebuild on every change.
features.options: --port <n>: dev server port (default devServerPort or 3000; 0 = any free port); --clean: empty the output before the first build; --strict: passed to every build.
features.rules: The whole project is watched except the output folder, node_modules, .git and editor temp files; every build runs in a fresh child process, so config, renderers, directives, package.json and tsconfig changes are always picked up; a stylesheet change only recompiles styles (CSS swapped without reload), a change to a file used only by the scripts only rebundles them, other changes rebuild pages (and styles with a custom stylesParser), changes outside src or to site code rebuild everything; errors are printed and shown in the browser overlay while the server keeps running; changes during a build are queued into one more build; pages are not minified.

features.summary: Hook called after every build, for site validations.
features.options: function (BuildResult: ok, durationMs, diagnostics, out, watchMode) → void | Promise
features.rules: Runs in build and watch (unlike npm postbuild); an exception fails the build.

features.summary: Hook called before every build.
features.rules: Runs in build and watch after the config is loaded and the output cleaned; an exception stops the build.

features.summary: Empties the output folder before each build.
features.rules: Dot files at the root of the output (.git, .nojekyll) are kept; in watch mode only full rebuilds clean (a styles- or scripts-only rebuild keeps the pages); without it, deleted pages stay in the output.

features.summary: Registers custom directive classes.
features.options: array of classes, run in this order
features.rules: Run after the built-in directives, for components and pages.

features.summary: Registers renderers by name.
features.rules: A custom renderer with the name of a built-in one replaces it.

features.summary: Port of the dev server.
features.rules: --port overrides it; the next free port is used if busy.

features.summary: Extra esbuild options merged into the scripts build.
features.rules: Merged over the defaults (entry, IIFE, target es2018, minify, define); overriding outfile/write changes where files go.

features.summary: The configuration is read from config/ with the rules of the config npm package.
features.usage: config/default.ts → export default { ... } as YassbConfig; config/production.ts merged when NODE_ENV=production.
features.options: NODE_CONFIG_DIR (folder, several separated by :), NODE_CONFIG_ENV / NODE_ENV (deployment, default development), NODE_APP_INSTANCE, HOST/HOSTNAME, NODE_CONFIG (JSON merged last).
features.rules: Files merged in order: default, {deployment}, {host}, {host}-{deployment}, local, local-{deployment}, each also as {name}-{instance}; extensions .js .cjs .ts .cts .mts .tsx .json; export default or module.exports; plain objects are merged deeply, arrays/functions/classes replaced; YAML/TOML/other formats are reported and skipped; a missing package imported by the config is explained (packages yassb-web 1.x used to install are named).

features.summary: Options of gray-matter for front matter.
features.rules: With excerpt, { excerpt } is available in generated pages.

features.summary: Options of html-minifier-terser for yassb build.
features.usage: htmlMinificationOptions: { collapseWhitespace: true, removeComments: true, minifyCSS: true }
features.rules: Not applied in watch; a page the minifier cannot parse is written unminified and reported.

features.summary: Options of the translation step.
features.options: allowHtml: insert translations as HTML (default false)
features.rules: Applies to data-t content, not to attributes.

features.summary: Functions applied to the final HTML of every page.
features.rules: Run in order after translation and front matter, before minification, in build and watch, for every HTML file of the output; an exception or a non-string result fails the build.

features.summary: Options of the Showdown Markdown converter.
features.rules: Replaces the default entirely (set tables again if needed).

features.summary: Public host of the site.
features.rules: Keeps sitemap.xml in the output, with this host in its URLs; url-to strips the host so links stay root-relative (a host without trailing slash yields //path links, as in 1.x).

features.summary: Disables sitemap.xml.
features.rules: url-to keeps working from memory; a sitemap written by a post processor is not deleted.

features.summary: Disables the stylesheet step.
features.rules: No CSS file is written; include-styles-src still inserts its link.

features.summary: Every reported error fails the build.
features.rules: Without it only fatal problems exit 1; warnings never fail.

features.summary: Replaces Sass with the site's own CSS pipeline (PostCSS, Tailwind…).
features.options: function (absolute entry, same entry, absolute output path) → string | Buffer | Promise
features.rules: Must return the CSS without writing it; runs after the pages (so Tailwind sees generated HTML); in watch it reruns on every page rebuild; an exception fails the build.

features.summary: Replaces USERNAME in directive values.
features.rules: Replaced in every directive before its attributes are read; unset gives the text "undefined".

features.summary: Legacy: bundles the scripts with the site's webpack configuration.
features.rules: Requires webpack (and loaders) installed in the site; the configuration decides entry and output; prefer esbuildOptions.

features.summary: Changes the folders of the project.
features.options: base, src, assets, i18n, app, pages, components, dataSources, pagesToGenerate, posts, scripts, styles, out, scriptsOutFolder, stylesOutFolder
features.rules: base relative to the current folder; src and out to base; assets, i18n, app to src; the others to app; scriptsOutFolder and stylesOutFolder to out; missing folders and empty script/style entries are created.

features.summary: { key } placeholders are replaced with front matter values.
features.rules: One space inside each brace; values come from Markdown files, components with front matter and the data returned by custom directives; strings inserted as they are (not escaped), dates and the date key as ISO strings, other values as JSON; replaced after components and again in post-processing.

features.summary: Markdown/text files are converted to HTML (Showdown) with YAML front matter (gray-matter).
features.usage: <!-- component="intro.md" -->, or the files of a generate-from-files folder.
features.rules: Front matter becomes { key } placeholders; excerpt and language found by gray-matter are added to the front matter; empty files are reported.

features.summary: Shared attribute syntax of directives: quoted values, JSON options, LANG and USERNAME placeholders.
features.options: options: JSON (object or array) written as is inside double or single quotes, anywhere in the directive.
features.rules: Values end at the closing quote; LANG anywhere in the directive (options included) becomes the current language; USERNAME becomes config.username (the text "undefined" if unset); invalid options JSON is reported and ignored.

features.summary: Inserts an HTML, SVG or Markdown fragment from the components folder, recursively.
features.options: The value is a path relative to src/app/components (workingDir.components); LANG and USERNAME are replaced (see directive.attributes).
features.rules: Each component is processed on its own (its directives run with fileFullPath = the component file) before being inserted into the including file; components can nest; .md/.txt components are converted from Markdown; front matter of a component becomes { key } placeholders of the page; a missing file leaves the comment in place (removed by the minifier); more than 40 levels of nesting is reported as a cycle; the regex accepts one directive per line.

features.summary: Renders a JSON data source with a renderer and inserts the resulting HTML.
features.options: renderer: name in customRenderers or a built-in renderer (default basicElement); options: JSON passed to the renderer as props.options.
features.rules: One JSON file per directive, path relative to src/app/data-sources (sub-folders allowed); the file is parsed again for every directive, so renderers may mutate their data; the renderer receives source (parsed JSON) and sourcePath; every occurrence of the same directive text in the file is replaced; a missing file or name leaves the comment (removed by the minifier) and is reported; invalid JSON or a throwing renderer fail the build.

features.summary: Generates one page per Markdown/text file from a template in pages-to-generate.
features.options: The value is a folder relative to src/app (workingDir.posts); USERNAME is replaced.
features.rules: The directive must be in the template file itself, not in a component; .md and .txt files are read recursively; output is <out>/<template folder>/<file sub-folder>/<slug>.html with slug = front matter slug, else the title in kebab-case, else the file name; front matter placeholders are replaced at once and again in post-processing; generated pages then go through all directives; with i18n only templates inside a language folder (pages-to-generate/en/...) are translated, so a multi-language blog needs one template per language.

features.summary: Inserts the script tag of the bundled browser script.
features.rules: The text must be exactly <!-- include-script-src -->; the URL follows workingDir.scripts, workingDir.scriptsOutFolder and the version of package.json.

features.summary: Inserts the stylesheet link of the compiled CSS.
features.rules: The text must be exactly <!-- include-styles-src -->; the URL follows workingDir.styles, workingDir.stylesOutFolder and the version of package.json.

features.summary: Lists the files of a folder of the output and renders them with a custom renderer.
features.options: renderer (required, must be in customRenderers); options: JSON passed to the renderer.
features.rules: The folder is relative to the output folder and scanned recursively in name order; source is [{ absolutePath, absoluteUrl }], sourcePath the scanned folder; only files already in the output are listed (assets are copied first).

features.summary: Replaced by the absolute URL of the output file whose path contains a fragment.
features.options: #anchor is kept; options="{"warning":false}" silences the ambiguity warning.
features.rules: The fragment is matched case-insensitively against every URL of the output (also as kebab-case and snake_case); with several matches the file closest to the current page wins, ties go to an index.html; with i18n only pages of languages already built are visible; the host (siteHost or the internal one) is stripped, so the result is root-relative (/en/about/index.html); no match inserts nothing and suggests the closest URL.

features.summary: The languages of the site are the names of the JSON files in src/i18n.
features.usage: src/i18n/en.json, src/i18n/it.json → every page built into <out>/en/ and <out>/it/
features.rules: Languages are sorted by name and processed in that order; the first one is served at / by the dev server; without the folder (or JSON files) the site is single-language and pages go to <out>/.

features.summary: Translates marked text and attributes of every page into each language.
features.usage:
Welcome

Welcome
features.options: config.i18n.allowHtml inserts translations as HTML; data-t-interpolate / data-attr-t-interpolate replace {{KEY}} placeholders.
features.rules: Runs after all directives, so renderer output is translated; data-t with no value uses the element text as key; any <attr>-t on an element with data-attr-t sets <attr>; keys are flat ("HOME.TITLE") or nested objects; a missing key keeps the original text; translation attributes are removed; only translated elements are rewritten, the rest of the page is kept byte for byte; translations are escaped as text unless allowHtml; pages outside language folders are not translated.

features.summary: Built-in renderer: one element per item, with item.description as content.
features.options: tag (default span); attributes: object applied to every element (true → bare attribute, false → omitted, arrays joined with spaces).
features.rules: source is an array of { description } or, with i18n, { description: { <lang>: text } }; descriptions are inserted as HTML; used as fallback when a directive has no or an unknown renderer.

features.summary:
Built-in renderer:
  • date: description
    • per item, with localized dates.
features.rules: date is { start, end } with YYYY, YYYY/MM or YYYY/MM/DD (formatted in the current language: "March 2020", "March 5, 2020"), end "-" means present (<span data-t="PRESENT">, translated by i18n), or { raw } inserted as is; description as in basicElement.

diagnostics.CONFIG_LOAD_FAILED: The configuration (config/*.ts|js|json) or a module it imports threw while loading.
diagnostics.CONFIG_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: The configuration imports a package that is not installed in the site.
diagnostics.CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED_FILE: A config file has a format YASSB 2 does not read (yaml, toml, …).
diagnostics.UNDECLARED_DEPENDENCY: Site code imports a package missing from package.json (it may work only by accident).
diagnostics.COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND: A `component` directive points to a file that does not exist.
diagnostics.COMPONENT_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: A `component` directive points to a file type that cannot be included.
diagnostics.DATA_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: `create-from-data-source` points to a JSON file that does not exist.
diagnostics.DATA_SOURCE_INVALID_JSON: A data source is not valid JSON.
diagnostics.OPTIONS_INVALID_JSON: The `options` attribute of a directive is not valid JSON.
diagnostics.RENDERER_MISSING: A directive has no `renderer` attribute; `basicElement` is used.
diagnostics.RENDERER_NOT_FOUND: The renderer named in a directive is not registered in `customRenderers`.
diagnostics.DIRECTIVE_NO_REGEX: A custom directive class has no static `regex`.
diagnostics.DIRECTIVE_FAILED: A custom directive threw an exception or returned no HTML.
diagnostics.DIRECTIVE_UNPROCESSED: A directive is still in the page after processing; its content is missing.
diagnostics.URL_TO_NOT_FOUND: `url-to` matches no file of the site.
diagnostics.URL_TO_AMBIGUOUS: `url-to` matches several files; the closest one is used.
diagnostics.PUBLIC_FILE_LIST_NOT_FOUND: `public-file-list` points to a folder that does not exist in the output.
diagnostics.TEMPLATE_NO_DIRECTIVE: A file in pages-to-generate has no `generate-from-files` directive.
diagnostics.TEMPLATE_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The folder of a `generate-from-files` directive does not exist.
diagnostics.MARKDOWN_EMPTY: A Markdown/text file used to generate a page is empty.
diagnostics.FRONT_MATTER_INVALID_DATE: A `date` front matter value is not a valid date.
diagnostics.I18N_MISSING_KEY: A translation key is used in a page but missing in a language file.
diagnostics.I18N_INVALID_FILE: A language file in the i18n folder is not valid JSON.
diagnostics.I18N_UNCLOSED_ELEMENT: An element with `data-t` has no closing tag, so it was not translated.
diagnostics.I18N_UNTRANSLATED_ATTRIBUTE: A `data-t`/`data-attr-t` attribute is left in the output.
diagnostics.I18N_UNUSED_KEY: A translation key is never used in the sources (it may be used by code).
diagnostics.I18N_INCONSISTENT_KEYS: A translation key exists in some languages but not in others.
diagnostics.POST_PROCESSOR_FAILED: A post processor threw an exception.
diagnostics.HOOK_FAILED: A beforeBuild/afterBuild hook threw an exception.
diagnostics.OUTPUT_LOCKED: Another YASSB process (build, check or watch) is writing the same output folder; nothing was written.
diagnostics.BUILD_CRASHED: The build process stopped unexpectedly (watch mode keeps serving the last output).
diagnostics.MINIFY_FAILED: The HTML minifier could not parse a page; the page was written unminified.
diagnostics.STYLES_FAILED: The stylesheet could not be compiled.
diagnostics.SCRIPTS_FAILED: The scripts could not be bundled.
diagnostics.LINK_BROKEN: A page links to a local file that is not in the output.
diagnostics.UNUSED_COMPONENT: A component is not used by any page.
diagnostics.UNUSED_DATA_SOURCE: A data source is not used by any page.
